high_level_description: stc brand style, a futuristic desk setup displaying a holographic 3D cityscape and data visualizations.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A cyberpunk-themed scene with vertical neon light tubes creating a tunnel effect in alternating blue and pink, reflected on a glossy desk surface.

elements.desc: A black monitor displaying a holographic 3D cityscape with tall buildings, data charts, graphs, and circular progress meters in cyan and pink.
A black wireless keyboard and mouse on the desk.
Small potted succulents in dark containers positioned on the left side of the desk.
